local function createUltraButton(text, callback)
	local Button = Instance.new("TextButton", Frame)
	Button.Text = text
	Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 30)
	Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	Button.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	Button.TextScaled = true
	Button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Button.AutoButtonColor = true
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", Button)
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

local debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local function megaExplosionAt(pos)
	local exp = Instance.new("Explosion")

	exp.BlastRadius = 1000
	exp.BlastPressure = 99999999999
	exp.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 1
	exp.Parent = workspace
	debris:AddItem(exp, 3)
end

local function megaVirusEffect(model)
	for _, part in pairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
			part.Transparency = 0.1
			part.Anchored = false
			local fire = Instance.new("Fire", part)
			fire.Heat = 1000
			fire.Size = 50

			local smoke = Instance.new("Smoke", part)
			smoke.Opacity = 0.9
			smoke.Size = 80
			debris:AddItem(smoke, 10)
		end
	end
end

	exp.BlastRadius = blastRadius or 1500

-- Helper: Mega Sis Oluştur
local function megaFogEffect(color, endDist, duration)
	lighting.FogColor = color or Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0)
	lighting.FogEnd = endDist or 50
	lighting.FogStart = 0
	wait(duration or 10)
	lighting.FogEnd = 100000
	lighting.FogColor = Color3.new(1,1,1)
end

-- Helper: Dünya Döndür ve Boz
local function rotateAndDestroyWorld()
	for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Anchored then
			RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				part.CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
				part.Transparency = math.min(part.Transparency + 0.005, 1)
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function callMegaLightning(pos)

	lightning.CanCollide = false

	lightning.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Institutional white")
	lightning.Size = Vector3.new(5, 100, 5)
	lightning.Position = pos + Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
	local flash = Instance.new("PointLight", lightning)
	flash.Brightness = 5000
	flash.Range = 300
	debris:AddItem(lightning, 1)
end
